title: Maximum Principles for Partially Observed Controls of Forward SPDEs and Backward SDEs with Jumps
summary: This work establishes two versions of the Pontryagin-type maximum principles for partially observed optimal control of coupled forward stochastic partial differential equations (FSPDEs) and backward stochastic differential equations (BSDEs) with jumps in convex control domains. The FSPDE-BSDE system is driven by cylindrical Wiener processes, finite-dimensional Brownian motions, and compensated Poisson random measures.
